_comment: MCP servers the client connects to. Contract v1 §7 names the network
transport 'http'; on mcp==2.0.0 that is Streamable HTTP at /mcp.
Tools are NEVER hardcoded here — contract v1 §9 requires runtime
discovery, so only the address and a timeout live in this file.
The other three interns' entries stay disabled until interop day; set
'enabled': true and the client picks them up on the next restart with no
code change. A disabled or unreachable server must not break the client:
that is the graceful-degradation case the brief requires.
Hospitality has no address yet: contract v1 section 7 still lists it as
pending. The previous value 10.10.180.0 was invented and is a network
address, never a host, so it could never have connected. Replace the
.invalid host once the owner publishes the real one.
